facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Economy published the summary of Senegal's national AI strategy and roadmap to 2028 (four objectives, six orientations), whose formulation it launched on 17 May 2023; the document gives no month, so as_of is its publication year.
